content.title: Jon Jones retires again after Dana White's UFC White House snub: 'No more fighter Jones'
content.text: Khamzat Chimaev is convinced his 20-year-old teammate is a future UFC champion.The UFC middleweight champion is building quite the team at the Santo Studios in California, where he now does most of his training.Ahead of his UFC 328 title defense, Khamzat Chimaev has been training with the likes of Khalil Rountree Jr, Brendan Allen and several other current MMA stars.But there is one fighter who is part of his team who he has guaranteed will become a future champion in the sport. Who wins in the main event of UFC 328 on May 9? Sean Strickland and Khamzat Chimaev finally get the chance to settle their bitter feud at Prudential Center, can the American beat the champ? I’m Khamzat Chimaev warns fans about Ansar Khamzaev20-year-old prospect Ansar Khamzaev has been training with Chimaev and his team ahead of his own fight on May 15.‘Borz’ fights at LFA 232 against Jordon Tague and he is looking to extend his professional MMA record to 6-0.Khamzaev also trains at Kill Cliff but recently has joined Chimaev’s team in California to prepare for his second lightweight fight in a row.A few months ago, the aforementioned Allen told Joe Rogan about the 20-year-old’s talents which seemed to have the UFC commentator excited. During their conversation, Allen mentioned how Khamzaev reminds him of a younger version of Chimaev.“Wow, he looks good, he looks good, man. If you’re that good at (20-years-old) what’s he gonna be like when he’s 30?” Rogan commented.And after sitting and watching him spar while he took a break from his own training, Chimaev guaranteed that the 20-year-old is a future champion in the sport.“Future champion. If he keeps working like this, Borz coming up,” Chimaev said in a video on Adam Zubayraev’s YouTube channel.“It’s deja vu to see when Khamzat was a kid, it’s exactly the same, like his temp is crazy, mini Khamzat,” Chimaev’s manager, Majdi Shammas said.20-year-old ‘Borz’ is hopeful that with a win on May 15, he will put himself on the radar of the UFC and may potentially earn himself a shot in the promotion.With the growing influence of Dana White’s Contender Series, it wouldn’t be surprising to see Khamzaev compete on the next season of the show.“After this fight, Inshallah a new UFC star,” Khamzaev said.Join Our NewsletterReceive a digest of our best Bloody Elbow content each week direct to your mailbox
